biological_sample_macro.weighting: average technical datasets within biological ID, then equal biological-sample weight

claim_ceiling: regional mutation-state topology profiles and cross-technical reproducibility; not biological clone distance, accuracy truth, or independent biological replication

definitions.TVD: half the L1 distance between mutually exclusive category proportions; 0=same composition, 1=no shared category mass
definitions.biological_sample_macro: technical datasets averaged within biological ID, then six biological IDs equally weighted
definitions.dataset_micro: raw W_primary counts summed across seven datasets; HCC1395 contributes two technical datasets
definitions.exact_coordinate_primary_match: identical chrom:start-end region key with a primary lineage in both datasets
definitions.profile_mean_tvd: unweighted mean of three dimension TVDs for navigation only

hcc1395_technical_pair.claim_ceiling: partial cross-technical reproducibility of current-v5 regional mutation-state labels; not accuracy truth, biological replication, confirmed clones, or interchangeable datasets
hcc1395_technical_pair.relationship: same biological sample; technical/cross-platform pair; not biological replication

hcc_exact_signature_evidence.claim_ceiling: cross-platform pipeline-output concordance for regional mutation-state topology; not biological sample-identity proof, confirmed clone, true ancestry, CCF, or probability

exact_region_both_candidate_unique_prequ.reason: internal sSNV equality is required before labeled edges are comparable

independent_current_v5_hcc_evidence.relationship: independent current-v5 evidence layer; exact allele-set region key, not the sidecar exact-coordinate key

operational_thresholds.note: Pre-registered operational display bands; not universal field cutoffs.

metric_contract.conditional_evaluable_mean_tvd: same unweighted mean after structural incomplete, read-AF unavailable/incomplete, and morphology unresolved are excluded and each dimension renormalized
metric_contract.primary: total variation distance on mutually exclusive W_primary category proportions
metric_contract.profile_mean_tvd: unweighted arithmetic mean of structural, read-AF-selection, and morphology TVD; navigation only, not biological distance

scope: 7 datasets / 6 biological samples / GRCh38 chr1-22 / current canonical v5
